question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing left back, Dave is playing fullback, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Claire and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) left back
(D) fullback
(E) center midfielder
(F) right midfielder
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: cheerleader, right winger, left back, fullback, center midfielder, right midfielder, goalkeeper
1. Alice–Dave: fullback, right winger, left back, cheerleader, center midfielder, right midfielder, goalkeeper
2. Bob–Dave: fullback, cheerleader, left back, right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder, goalkeeper
3. Claire–Alice: left back, cheerleader, fullback, right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder, goalkeeper
4. Bob–Fred: left back, right midfielder, fullback, right winger, center midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper
5. Gertrude–Dave: left back, right midfielder, fullback, goalkeeper, center midfielder, cheerleader, right winger
6. Fred–Gertrude: left back, right midfielder, fullback, goalkeeper, center midfielder, right winger, cheerleader
7. Claire–Bob: left back, fullback, right midfielder, goalkeeper, center midfielder, right winger, cheerleader
Claire's final position is right midfielder, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
